headline: 42.0m AT 6.1% CuEq AND 51.5m AT 4.9% CuEq IN CORE ZONE — FIREFLY METALS REVEALS GRADE THAT SUPER-CHARGES EARLY MINE ECONOMICS, ECONOMIC STUDY DUE JULY-AUGUST (ASX/TSX:FFM)
snippet: FireFly Metals Ltd. (ASX/TSX:FFM) released assays on July 2, 2026 from the Core Zone at its Green Bay Copper-Gold Project in Newfoundland and Labrador, returning 42.0 metres at 6.1% CuEq (4.7% Cu + 1.4 g/t Au), 51.5 metres at 4.9% CuEq, and additional intervals of 25.3m at 3.8%, 35.7m at 3.3%, and 43.5m at 3.0% CuEq — among the strongest copper equivalent grades reported by a junior development company anywhere in Canada this cycle. The Core Zone currently holds 8.8Mt at 3.9% CuEq M&I and 10.9Mt at 3.8% CuEq Inferred within a total project MRE of 50.4Mt at 2.0% CuEq M&I and 29.3Mt Inferred; an updated economic study incorporating the new Core Zone results is expected July-August 2026. FireFly holds approximately A$219.9 million in cash, meaning Green Bay is funded to study completion without dilution risk.

headline: 738m OF CONTINUOUS GOLD-COPPER-MOLY MINERALIZATION TO 1km DEPTH — GOLD HART COPPER CONFIRMS FERTILE KILOMETRE-SCALE PORPHYRY SYSTEM IN CHILE'S VICUÑA DISTRICT, 8 MORE HOLES IN 2026 (TSXV:HART)
snippet: Gold Hart Copper Corp. (TSXV:HART) announced July 2, 2026 that drill hole DDHTOL01 at the Tolita gold-copper-molybdenum-silver asset in Chile's Vicuña District returned 738 metres of continuous multi-generation porphyry-style mineralization in a hole drilled to 1,053 metres depth — the longest mineralized interval ever reported at Tolita. The company described the geological signatures in DDHTOL01 as 'among the most significant encountered to date' in terms of structural positioning and hydrothermal alteration, confirming the system as a kilometre-scale, fertile porphyry environment with no barren breaks through the entire intercept. Eight additional 2026 spring season holes remain. The Vicuña District hosts several world-class copper-gold porphyry deposits; surface trenches at Tolita have previously returned up to 52 g/t AuEq including 4% copper.

headline: 1.88 g/t AU OVER 4.85m CONFIRMS GOLD-ANTIMONY CORRELATION — GLOBEX'S BALD HILL OPTION PARTNER ADDS THIRD DRILL RIG, 600m DEFINITION PROGRAM UNDERWAY IN CRITICAL-MINERAL HOT ZONE (TSX:GMX)
snippet: Globex Mining Enterprises Inc. (TSX:GMX) reported July 3, 2026 that option partner Antimony Resources Corp. has completed gold assay evaluation across 190 intersections in 45+ drill holes at the Bald Hill property in New Brunswick, establishing a strong spatial correlation between high-grade antimony and gold — with the best interval returning 1.88 g/t gold over 4.85 metres in the Main Antimony Zone. Antimony Resources has now deployed two drill rigs with a third to be added to systematically sample a 600-metre strike length to 300 metres depth, targeting a maiden resource estimate. Antimony is listed as a U.S. and EU critical mineral under Chinese export restrictions — making primary Western antimony deposits rare and strategically important — and Bald Hill sits within New Brunswick's Bathurst Mining Camp, which hosts established base-metal processing infrastructure.

headline: CPM GROUP: GOLD AND SILVER CHART IS A REPEAT OF EARLY 2025 — CONSOLIDATION BEFORE A SURGE, NOT A STRUCTURAL BREAK; NEAR-TERM PRESSURE BEFORE Q3 RECOVERY
snippet: CPM Group's July 3, 2026 analysis for Kitco draws a direct technical and fundamental parallel between gold and silver's 2026 correction and the mid-2025 consolidation that preceded a strong multi-month rally — arguing that both metals sitting on long-term support after a sharp pullback sets up a Q3 recovery rather than a structural bear market. Gold is down roughly 25% from the January $5,589 high while silver declined over 21% in Q2 2026, but CPM Group notes that corrections of this magnitude within long-term bull markets are historically resolved higher over the following two to six months, with economic and geopolitical tail risks — trade escalation, U.S. fiscal deterioration, and emerging-market de-dollarisation — remaining firmly in place. The firm expects metals could remain under near-term pressure into August before moving sharply higher in late Q3 and Q4 2026.

headline: ATHABASCA UNCONFORMITY INTERSECTED IN ALL THREE WINTER HOLES — REFINED ENERGY CONFIRMS STRUCTURAL TARGET AT DUFFERIN WEST WITH URANIUM ANOMALY BELOW CONTACT (CSE:RUU)
snippet: Refined Energy Corp. (CSE:RUU) announced July 4, 2026 that all three holes in its winter 2026 drill program at the Dufferin West Project in Saskatchewan's Athabasca Basin successfully intersected the Athabasca unconformity — the structural contact that hosts the Basin's world-class high-grade uranium deposits — and returned ten anomalous sample intervals including uranium enrichment relative to thorium immediately below the contact. The highest single assay from DW26-001 returned 5 ppm uranium directly below the unconformity, consistent with early-stage basement-hosted uranium alteration. While the program was reconnaissance-scale in design (975 metres across three holes), the confirmed unconformity intersection and uranium anomalism justify drilling toward the enriched basement targets identified in the 2025 surface geophysics campaign.

headline: CANADA ICA CLEARED, ECOWAS AND COMESA APPROVED — ZIJIN'S C$44/SHARE ALLIED GOLD TAKEOUT RACES TO JULY 29 DEADLINE AS FINAL AFRICAN CLEARANCES ADVANCE (TSX:AAUC)
snippet: Allied Gold Corp. (TSX:AAUC) and Zijin Gold International confirmed receipt of Investment Canada Act approval for Zijin's C$44.00-per-share all-cash acquisition, alongside competition clearances from ECOWAS and COMESA covering West and East African jurisdictions. Several African host-country approvals are at advanced stages. The outside date has been extended to July 29, 2026 as parties finalise remaining regulatory conditions; any further extension requires mutual consent. At C$44/share, the deal values Allied Gold — a multi-asset producer operating in Mali, Côte d'Ivoire, and Ethiopia — at approximately C$3.5 billion and ranks among the largest Chinese-capital acquisitions of a Canadian gold producer. The ICA clearance removes the most significant Western regulatory hurdle.

headline: WARSH AT ECB FORUM: INFLATION 'STILL TOO HIGH,' DECLINES JULY GUIDANCE — BUT PAYROLLS MISS COLLAPSES RATE-HIKE BETS BELOW 50% AS GOLD HOLDS $4,170+ INTO HOLIDAY
snippet: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh declined to provide forward guidance at the ECB's Sintra forum on July 1, 2026, stating only that inflation 'remains too high' and that the Fed is 'charting a new course' on policy communication — but markets, emboldened by the June payrolls miss (57,000 versus 110,000 consensus), interpreted the silence as tacit confirmation that September hikes are off the table. CME FedWatch probability of a September hike fell below 50%, extending the metals rally that began with the payrolls print and pushing gold to $4,183 on July 3 for its first weekly gain since late May. For junior mining investors, rate-hike probability is the primary driver of U.S. dollar strength and real yields — both of which have been the chief headwinds to gold, silver, and mining equities since February 2026.

headline: SILVER CORRECTION TECHNICALLY COMPLETE — ANALYST TARGETS $68-72 NEXT LEG AS INDUSTRIAL DEMAND ABSORBS SPECULATIVE EXITS AND GOLD-SILVER RATIO HITS 67x
snippet: A July 1, 2026 technical analysis on Seeking Alpha argues that silver's correction from the $66 high is complete, with the metal finding support at the 200-day moving average and long-term uptrend line while China's industrial accumulation — over 790 tonnes imported in H1 2026 for solar manufacturing — continued absorbing speculative selling from Western accounts. The gold-to-silver ratio at 67x represents a historically wide premium to long-term 50–55x averages, which the author frames as a mean-reversion catalyst for a $68-72/oz target in the next structural leg. With the structural H1 supply deficit now estimated at 140+ million ounces and the Fed pivot from hike to cut risk removing the primary macro headwind, the analysis positions the $60–62 range as the last high-probability accumulation window before institutional buying returns.

headline: DOE AWARDS $75M TO EXTRACT RARE EARTHS AND GERMANIUM FROM DOMESTIC COAL FEEDSTOCKS — FIVE U.S. PILOT SITES TO PROVE UNCONVENTIONAL CRITICAL MINERALS RECOVERY
snippet: The U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Critical Minerals and Energy Innovation awarded $75 million to five projects developing pilot-scale recovery of rare earth elements, germanium, gallium, and aluminum from coal and coal-based feedstocks, with selected sites including the University of North Dakota and Peabody Energy in Missouri. Germanium and gallium have become the most geopolitically sensitive technology metals of this cycle after China implemented export licensing controls that have reduced approval rates to below 25% for some Western industrial buyers. For junior mining investors, the DOE's pivot to non-traditional feedstocks underscores the urgency of the Western supply deficit and validates the risk-premium now attached to domestic critical minerals projects — including primary-mining explorers in Canada, Australia, and the United States holding conventional deposit types.

headline: 87% HIT RATE, TWO NEW LENSES FOUND, 50,000m PHASE 2 DRILLING NOW — SELKIRK COPPER'S MINTO MINE RESTART IS ON TRACK FOR MID-2028 WITH PEA AND RESOURCE UPDATE DUE THIS MONTH (TSXV:SCMI)
source_name: Crux Investor / Selkirk Copper Mines Inc. (TSXV:SCMI)
snippet: A July 2026 Crux Investor analysis on Selkirk Copper Mines (TSXV:SCMI / OTCQB:SKRKF) outlines the company's case for a mid-2028 restart of the Minto Copper-Gold-Silver Mine in the Yukon following Phase 1 drilling (52,288 metres in 175 holes) with an 87% economic-grade hit rate and two newly discovered mineral lenses (117 and 301) adjacent to existing mine infrastructure — one of the highest hit-rates of any copper restart program currently active in Canada. Phase 2 drilling (50,000 metres) is running ahead of schedule with assays expected October-November 2026, feeding a feasibility study starting August 2026 targeted for completion by mid-2027. An updated Preliminary Economic Assessment and fresh Mineral Resource Estimate are expected this month. Minto is serviced by an all-season road from the Alaska Highway, giving it a decisive infrastructure advantage over remote greenfield copper projects.
